header: Is what was typed an IDENTIFIER (a ticket, a P.No, a mobile number, a short number) rather than words? Such a question is answered from the employee directory and is never sent to circular search. I keep ONE definition, used by the search hook and by the search modal (they had two copies that could drift apart). A four-digit number that is a plausible YEAR (1990 to 2100: "2025", "2024") is NOT an identifier: people type it to find the circulars of that year, and treating it as an ID made Enter do nothing for them.
